AGREEMENT AND PLAN OF MERGER
THIS AGREEMENT AND PLAN OF MERGER (this “Agreement”) is made and entered into as of May 4, 2025, by and among Beach Acquisition Co Parent, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (“Parent”), Beach Acquisition Merger Sub, Inc., a Delaware corporation and a direct or indirect Subsidiary of Parent that is treated as a direct Subsidiary of Parent for U.S. federal income tax purposes (“Merger Sub”, and together with Parent, the “Buyer Parties”), and Skechers U.S.A., Inc., a Delaware corporation (the “Company”). Each of the Company, Parent and Merger Sub is sometimes referred to as a “Party.” All capitalized terms that are used in this Agreement have the respective meanings given to them in Article I.
RECITALS
A. The Company Board has established a committee of independent and disinterested members of the Company Board (the “Independent Committee”).
B.
